request.style: English, female solo voice with warm celtic choir, acoustic guitar, fiddle, bodhran, flute, harp, uplifting and majestic, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I rejoice in the pain for your sake
Flesh fills the gap in the cross
For the body of Christ, the church
I serve by the gift he has sent

[Verse]
To make the word of God known
The mystery hidden in ages
Now revealed to his saints
Chosen to see the riches

[Chorus]
Christ in you, the hope of glory
Glorious riches among Gentiles
Christ in you, the hope of glory
The mystery now made plain

[Verse]
We proclaim him with all wisdom
Admonish and teach everyone
Presenting you mature in Christ
Laboring by his strong power

[Chorus]
Christ in you, the hope of glory
Glorious riches among Gentiles
Christ in you, the hope of glory
The mystery now made plain

[Bridge]
Not my power but his working
Moving within my flesh
Completing the afflictions
For the sake of the church

[Chorus]
Christ in you, the hope of glory
Glorious riches among Gentiles
Christ in you, the hope of glory
The mystery now made plain

[Outro]
Christ in you, the hope of glory
